ladder.label: config/battery.yaml as committed: 2h, k=2, SoC carries
4 hours of storage at the same 1 MW
each market day opens and closes half full — no carryover
SoC carries but closing inventory is unvalued

bootstrap.pairing: one day multiset per replicate, applied to both rungs of a contrast — the two rungs are the same forecast on the same days, so the difference distribution carries none of the variation they share
bootstrap.warning: a wider block does not mean a wider interval at n = 365 (C12); the ladder is a robustness check, not an ordering — read the rung least favourable to the claim

baseline_reproduction.note: C13's file carries C11's 2024 column unchanged, so one check binds C15's base rung to both cycles' published numbers.

friction.note_c13_02: the throughput-cost ladder is a friction measurement, not NO2's mechanism test — FINDING C13-E settled that

stress_cell.note_c13_02: the stress cell for the friction ladder: the thinnest market in the sample, below C13's declared thin-regime floor, and the cell that raised FLAG C13-01

boundary_inventory.why: two rungs end the year in different states — `soc_no_terminal` empty, `soc_daily_reset` half full, `base` holding whatever the trailing mark told it to hold — so part of any cash difference is inventory one run still owns. This bounds that part at the year's highest realised price, which is strictly generous.

spearman_is_rung_invariant.why_it_cannot_fail: the within-day Spearman is computed from the forecast and the realised prices on the ladder-common days; no rung changes either, so a non-zero drift would mean two rungs were pooled over different day sets — a bug, not a result

note_c14_01.prediction_as_written: NO2's within-day ordering will not improve at any rung
note_c14_01.verdict: untestable by this ladder, and asserted instead
note_c14_01.substantive_form_tested: if NO2's capture deficit were friction, removing the friction (throughput_0) would close it

res_degradation.note_c14_06: NOTE C8-01 is closed (FINDING C14-G), so C15 adds no exogenous model arm; this leg re-dispatches C8's and C9's committed forecasts to ask whether the Art. 14 leak's *dispatch* value depends on the battery

invariant_flags.note: CLAUDE.md's invariants, run on every rung of every curve of every cell. A non-empty `failures` block is a FLAG for PROGRESS.md and the dispatch phase exits non-zero; it is never a reason to relax a check. FLAG C13-01 and FLAG C14-01 are the two already-explained pooled naive-dominance failures this project carries, and a rung that reproduces one of them is reproducing a known regime fact.
